Direction from Jack Heart (2026-11-27) after reviewing scratch/concept-review.html and scratch/ship-review.html:
1. Fix F1 (unified Placement): fold `checkpoint_bytes`, `reason`, and a single `describe()` into `Placement` (matching `310ac1`'s single-owner `ExecutionPlan` shape), removing the 3 duplicate `agent_bytes()` computations and the double startup banner on mixed `play` + `play_many` GPU runs across `resources.py`, `run.py`, and `agents.py`.
2. Fix F2 (socket request unpickle guard): catch `Exception` (not just `(EOFError, OSError)`) around `ForkingPickler.loads(payload)` in `_run_agents` (`batching.py`) so a bad request frame isolates only that peer with a redacted error instead of killing the shared agent process for healthy games.
3. Diagnose and fix the 3 Linux CI failures on PR #153 (https://github.com/loopflowstudio/etude/actions/runs/45982421404/job/140449500529):
   - `tests/eval/test_match.py::test_a_launched_eval_run_that_fails_reports_what_it_played_and_what_failed`
   - `tests/eval/test_tournament.py::test_checkpoints_held_on_the_go_then_a_seating_added_in_batch`
   - `tests/test_page_evals.py::test_partially_scored_seated_point_keeps_failed_and_unplayed_counts`
4. Run full tests/mypy/ruff and republish PR #153 back to `ship-review`.
